name: What are the best kitchen flooring materials for durability and moisture resistance?

mainEntity.name: What are the best kitchen flooring materials for durability and moisture resistance?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen flooring, materials known for durability and moisture resistance include porcelain or ceramic tile, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and natural stone. Porcelain tile is highly water-resistant and withstands heavy traffic. LVP offers excellent water resistance, comfort underfoot, and mimicry of wood or stone. Natural stone, such as granite or slate, is durable and moisture-resistant when properly sealed, adding a premium aesthetic. Each material offers a balance of longevity, maintenance, and style.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain or ceramic tile, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and sealed natural stone are excellent choices for durable and moisture-resistant kitchen flooring.
